HOLDING FEE
A non-refundable holding fee is required to secure your appointment.
This covers the reservation of your time slot and is a payment towards the service.
The remaining balance must be paid via bank transfer or cash at your appointment.
In the unlikely event that your appointment needs to be cancelled by the stylist, your
holding fee will be refunded or transferred to a future date.
RESCHEDULING
Any changes made within 48 hours, or appointments moved to a later
date, will require a new holding fee.
NO EXTRA GUESTS
Due to health and safety, no additional guests are permitted.

LATE POLICY

If you are running late, please inform us as soon as possible.

A 15-minute grace period is provided.

After this time, a late fee (£15) will be applied if the appointment can still be
accommodated.

Arrivals beyond 25 minutes may result in the appointment being cancelled and the
holding fee being retained.

Failure to attend without notice result in refusal of future bookings.

OUT OF HOURS

£15 out-of-hours fee.

AVALIABLITY

Appointments are released on the 15th of each month at 8PM.

FOR NEW CLIENTS

Bundles must not be excessively cut.

All bundles must be freshly washed, fully detangled, and completely air-dried
prior to your appointment.

FOR EXISTING CLIENTS

Re-used bundles must be freshly washed and completely free from matting,
thread, and glue residue.

Failure to meet these requirements may result in additional preparation fees
or the service being adjusted based on time availability.

HAIR REQUIREMENTS

12"-14" — 2 bundles

16"-18" — 3 bundles

20"-24" — 3-4 bundles

26"+ — 4 bundles

HAIR QUALITY

your appointment to allow for preparation

All bundles are professionally washed, conditioned, and air-dried prior to your
appointment to ensure they are fully prepped and ready for installation.
Hair-included packages are also available when booking.
A limited selection of bundles may be available at the studio. Current stock will be
shared via highlights.
CLIENT CARE & STUDIO POLICIES
We welcome feedback and ask that any concerns are raised
within 48 hours. We reserve the right to refuse service where
studio policies are not respected.

Welcome to HairCupidLondon
At HairCupidLondon, healthy hair is our love language—spoken fluently, luxuriously, and without
compromise.
We specialise in preserving the integrity of natural hair while enhancing its beauty with premium,
meticulously applied extensions. Since our founding in 2019, our mission has remained unwavering: to set
the standard for healthy hair through exceptional craftsmanship, personalised care, and an
uncompromising commitment to excellence.

Every appointment is delivered by our skilled team with precision, artistry, and attention to detail. We
believe luxury is found in the experience as much as the result—creating scrong foundations, seamless
blends, and flawless finishes that are never rushed or replicated, only tailored.

At HairCupidLondon, healthy hair is never an afterthought—it is the foundation of everything we do.
Whether you choose a silk press, sew-in, tape-in extensions, or a restorative treatment, every service begins
with a thorough consultation, honest professional advice, and a bespoke haircare plan designed around
your hair’s condition, lifestyle, and long-term goals.

To ensure an elevated experience from start to finish, we also provide premium luxury-grade hair for all
extension services. Carefully sourced for longevity, softness, and seamless blending, every installation is
completed using hair that meets our exacting standards—delivering beauty, durability, and distinction.
Because true luxury begins at the root. When your crown is healthy, every style becomes extraordinary.

LOCATION
We are based in north east London (Islington). The closest stations are
Dalston Junction/ Dalston Kingsland for the overground, and Highbury &
Islington for the underground.

Mobile appointments for special circumstances and group bookings are
available on request. These are subject to availability, and must be booked
via email.

DEPOSITS
In order to book an appointment, you must pay a NON-REFUNDABLE deposit
of £15. The remainder should be paid in cash on the day of the appointment.
This will not be returned unless the appointment is cancelled by us.
LATENESS, CANCELLATION &
RESCHEDULING
Each appointment includes a 20-minute grace period. If you arrive more than
20 minutes late, a £10 fee will apply. After 40 minutes, your appointment will
be cancelled. Please keep us informed of your progress if you anticipate
lateness.

Rescheduling is permitted up to 48 hours before the appointment via the
booking link. Requests to reschedule within the 48-hour window will require a
new deposit.

Cancellations do not incur any extra charges however your deposit will not
be refunded. No-shows will be blocked from booking again in the future, and
the deposit will not be returned.

EMERGENCY SLOTS
All slots will be available to book until the day before the appointment.
Emergency slots are those booked not listed on the booking site. If you want
a slot which is not listed, please send us an email or DM. Such appointments
will incur a £10 additional charge.
HAIR PREP
Please arrive with clean, dry, and detangled hair, free of excess product. Dirty
hair will result in the cancellation of your appointment and a return of your
deposit. Please avoid applying greases or oils; appropriate products will be
used during the service. You are welcome to bring specific products if
desired.

Ensure your hair is detangled and any previous style is completely removed.
While blow-drying is not required, we can provide it at no additional cost if
necessary.

Hair in colours 1, 1b, 2, 4, 30, and 27, as well as synthetic and human hair
curls for goddess styles, can be selected as add-ons when booking. If you do
not choose an add-on, please bring pre-stretched hair on the day. Mixes are
available but must be selected on the booking site and noted in the
appointment details.

The standard length for all styles is mid-back. Anything longer must be
